(1) f2 phage RNA is infective on Escherichia coli protoplasts and not infective when added to whole cells; (2) the infectivity is dependent on the host; (3) the infectivity depends on the presence of a functional host RNA polymerase; (4) infectivity is dependent upon the host's ribosomal RNA and ribosomal proteins; (5) infectivity of f2 phage is not dependent on the host's tRNA;
the RNA of f2 is a determinant of host range and that the host range is determined by the interaction between RNA and the host cell.
